name: Corn & Soybeans: Backwardation vs Contango Regimes
description: Analyzes backwardation vs contango regimes in corn (ZC) and soybeans (ZS) over the last 5 years using carry-to-price ratio (front minus back contract / front price). Shows regime frequency by year, carry time series with area fill, and whether current backwardation predicts positive roll yield over the next quarter (63 trading days). Uses NoAdjustment for meaningful carry levels. Event markers capture each regime flip.
source:
# =============================================================================
# CORN & SOYBEANS: BACKWARDATION VS CONTANGO REGIMES
# =============================================================================
# Question: How often is each grain market in backwardation, and does it
#   predict the next quarter's roll yield?
#
# Carry signal: carry-to-price ratio = (front - back) / front
#   Positive = backwardation (front > back, positive roll yield)
#   Negative = contango (front < back, negative roll yield)
#
# NoAdjustment used for carry — preserves true price relationships (D16).
# Forward roll yield = carry-to-price ratio 63 bars ahead (S46: use << not forward_returns).
#
# Assets: ZC (Corn), ZS (Soybeans) — same formula runs independently per asset.
# =============================================================================

# --- Data ---
src = market_data_source()()

cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment,
    i_offset=0
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

close = cont.c
raw_carry = cont.carry   # front - back contract price ($)

# --- Carry-to-price ratio (comparable across ZC and ZS) ---
# Guard: only compute when close > 0 and carry is valid
carry_ratio = where(is_valid(raw_carry) and close > 0, raw_carry / close)

# Smooth with 5-day MA to reduce noise from roll artifacts
carry_ratio_smooth = ma(period=5, type=MAType.sma)(carry_ratio)

# --- Regime classification ---
# Backwardation: carry_ratio > 0 (front > back)
# Contango: carry_ratio <= 0 (front < back)
in_backwardation = is_valid(carry_ratio_smooth) and carry_ratio_smooth > 0

# --- Forward roll yield (next quarter = 63 trading days ahead) ---
# Per S46: use << operator for forward level of a signal, NOT forward_returns
# This is the carry-to-price ratio the market will be at in 63 bars
fwd_carry_63d = carry_ratio_smooth << 63

# --- Regime flip detection for event markers ---
# Flip to backwardation: was contango, now backwardation
flip_to_backwardation = crossover(carry_ratio_smooth, 0)
# Flip to contango: was backwardation, now contango
flip_to_contango = crossunder(carry_ratio_smooth, 0)
# Any regime flip
any_flip = flip_to_backwardation or flip_to_contango

# Regime label for event marker badge
regime_label = 'Backwardation' if (is_valid(carry_ratio_smooth) and carry_ratio_smooth > 0) else 'Contango'

# --- Annual backwardation frequency (for bar chart) ---
# 1.0 on backwardation days, 0.0 on contango days
backwardation_flag = 1.0 if (is_valid(carry_ratio_smooth) and carry_ratio_smooth > 0) else 0.0

# Year label for grouping
year_num = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.year)(index())

# --- Predictive stats: carry-to-price filtered by regime ---
carry_in_backwardation = where(in_backwardation, carry_ratio_smooth)
carry_in_contango = where(not in_backwardation and is_valid(carry_ratio_smooth), carry_ratio_smooth)

# Forward carry positive flag (for hit rate)
fwd_positive_flag = 1.0 if (is_valid(fwd_carry_63d) and fwd_carry_63d > 0) else 0.0

# Hit rate: when in backwardation today, is carry positive in 63 days?
hit_when_backwardation = where(in_backwardation and is_valid(fwd_carry_63d), fwd_positive_flag)
# Hit rate: when in contango today, is carry positive in 63 days?
hit_when_contango = where(not in_backwardation and is_valid(carry_ratio_smooth) and is_valid(fwd_carry_63d), fwd_positive_flag)

# Days count flags (for summary table row 2)
backwardation_count_flag = 1.0 if (is_valid(carry_ratio_smooth) and carry_ratio_smooth > 0) else 0.0
contango_count_flag = 1.0 if (is_valid(carry_ratio_smooth) and carry_ratio_smooth <= 0) else 0.0

bar_ts = index()

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 1: REFERENCE TABLE — Does backwardation predict next quarter roll yield?
# (Tables before charts per R10)
# =============================================================================
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Does Carry Regime Predict Next Quarter Roll Yield?',
        row_size=3,
        col_size=2,
        row_headers=['Fwd Carry Hit Rate (63d)', 'Avg Carry-to-Price', 'Days in Regime (5Y)'],
        col_headers=['Backwardation', 'Contango'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,
                       type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1,
                       info='% of backwardation days where carry is still positive 63 trading days later'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,
                       type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1,
                       info='% of contango days where carry turns positive within 63 trading days'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,
                       type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3,
                       info='Mean carry-to-price ratio on backwardation days'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,
                       type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3,
                       info='Mean carry-to-price ratio on contango days'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum,
                       type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, dp=0,
                       info='Total trading days in backwardation over 5 years'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum,
                       type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, dp=0,
                       info='Total trading days in contango over 5 years')
        ]
    ),
    category='Grain Carry Regimes',
    order=0
)(hit_when_backwardation, hit_when_contango, carry_in_backwardation, carry_in_contango, backwardation_count_flag, contango_count_flag)

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 2: CONTEXT — Carry-to-price ratio time series (area fill shows regimes)
# Positive area = backwardation, negative area = contango
# =============================================================================
xy_lines(
    title='Carry-to-Price Ratio: When Is the Market in Backwardation?',
    category='Grain Carry Regimes',
    area=True,
    y_axis_label='Carry / Front Price',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero (Regime Boundary)')
    ]),
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Carry-to-Price (5d MA)', color=Color.Blue, area=True)
    ]),
    order=1
)(x_values=bar_ts, y_values=carry_ratio_smooth)

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 3: PUNCHLINE — Annual % of days in backwardation
# =============================================================================
xy_bars(
    title='How Often Is Each Market in Backwardation? (% of Days by Year)',
    category='Grain Carry Regimes',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    y_axis_label='% of Days in Backwardation',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    data_labels=True,
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Exact,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.5, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='50% (Equal Time)')
    ]),
    order=2
)(values=backwardation_flag, label=year_num)

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 4: EVENT MAP — Regime flip event markers
# =============================================================================
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Carry Regime Flip',
        icon=Icon.ArrowUpDownIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(
                title='New Regime',
                type=CardRenderType.BadgeFormat,
                card_slot=CardSlot.PrimaryBadge,
                card_color_map={"Success": ["Backwardation"], "Error": ["Contango"]}
            ),
            ColumnSpec(
                title='Carry-to-Price',
                type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
                dp=3,
                card_slot=CardSlot.Hero
            ),
            ColumnSpec(
                title='Front Price',
                type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                dp=2,
                card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle
            ),
            ColumnSpec(
                table_is_filter=True,
                table_visible=False
            )
        ]
    )
)(regime_label, carry_ratio_smooth, close, any_flip)
